_comment: #2536: one set of worker-log tails, read by BOTH decisions. tools/muse-cli-shim.py's _classify must give `shim` (null: nothing) and `shimResetsAt`; agent/ModelFallback.classify must give `java` and `javaResetsAt` (0: none). Where the shim names a kind, Java names the same one; Java's extra rows (the Claude CLI's wording, a plain rate limit) are ones the shim does not read. Tested by agent/ModelFallbackTest and tools/test-muse-cli-shim.py.
